title: Twelve features, fanned out
description: one spoke per feature · big dot = launch week, sized by MAU today · small dots = every week since

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered feature labels and nonnegative finite launch weeks. Caller order assigns spokes, and week determines radius. Missing weeks reserve a spoke position with an unavailable label.

props.name: guideWeeks
props.description: Caller-owned nonnegative finite week references. Duplicate or invalid guides are omitted; the plot includes the supplied guides.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
